_comment: Statue (CASTLE 0.3) + rubble (CAVE) dressing per the family recipe, decor+blocked pairs (the ruin_surface boulder convention).

arrival_toasts.text: The fissure Zevara spoke of is down past the gallery. The dark has a direction today.

segments._comment: A fallen lintel span, interior texture only (ruin_surface's own minimal from/to-only precedent)

floor_layers._pick: Cemetery-floor variation reusing the dungeon biome's own verified floor-tile neighborhood (2,2)/(3,7) plus the genuinely darker worn variant (2,11) for real wear texture.

decor._comment: CASTLE 0.3 statue dressing, blocked-pair (THE BLOCKING CONTRACT).
CAVE rubble dressing (a collapse band), blocked-pair.

entities._comment: Met, it becomes a real door to `deep_tunnels`, landing at (13,5)
entities.observe: Rubble and worked stone choke a passage that clearly led somewhere once. Someone sealed this side deliberately, and not long ago either.
entities.toast: The stone doesn't budge. Whatever's on the other side stays sealed. For now.

door_when.open_toast: The rubble gives at your push -- someone's already cleared a path through. The old gallery beyond is dark, but it is open.

entities.observe: A carved shape crouches against the far wall, limbs folded, its eyeless face turned to the floor. It has not moved since you noticed it. That is the only reason you are still standing here.
entities.toast: You keep your distance. Whatever wakes it, you would rather not be the one who finds out.

entities._comment: Grouped with Yvlon/Ksmvr at (7,5)-(9,5), open floor clear of every blocked/decor/entity cell on this map.
entities._comment_dig: 2026-07-27 Task 2.7 round 2 (controller-sanctioned): retires PERMANENTLY at horns_dig_joined. The delve-staging Horns had no present_when at all, so once round 1 fixed the inn-vs-camp bilocation the SAME bug relocated here -- during The Dig a player could meet camp-Ceria at the ruin and delve-hub-Ceria on the approach in one trip. No `_returned` twin on the delve maps, deliberately: the Horns moved on from the delve staging for good (the_horns_home already has them living at the inn; the dig and then the mounting is what brings them there). Safe for the seal beat -- this row is only gameplay-load-bearing during what_the_seal_kept, and seal_kept_reported gates the dig invitation, so horns_dig_joined cannot bank until that quest is done. Verified at QA level too: every script touching this map (delve_fight, delve_skill, delve_talk, dungeon_peek, dungeon_kingslayer_loop) runs on a fixture with horns_dig_joined absent, so no entity-count pin moves.

entities._comment: Own graph (yvlon_intro.json): a hub whose default/text_variants carry the pool bark / halls-anticipating line / post-victory line, no gate of her own (Ceria owns the party-formed beat).
